svg.text: Backward of the same MLP block, SP on (the SP-off alternative is in grey in each bar)
Read left to right in execution order: the gradient enters from the block above and leaves to the block below. Each forward collective is mirrored (figure 1, fact 2).
Weight gradients of fc1 (inside the same backward call, rank 0 shown; rank 1 is the same with its own shard)
needs every token of x, hence the re-gather
SP off: x was saved full ([256, 2, 512]), so there is no ALL-GATHER #2.
That is SP's trade: half the stored activation, one extra all-gather per column-parallel linear.
fc2's weight grad dA2r = arT·dz needs nothing extra: ar is in the TP region.
Once per step, after the schedule: ALL-REDUCE of the LayerNorm γ, β and row-parallel bias (b2) gradients
With SP each rank saw only its 128 tokens, so its dγ, dβ, db2 are partial sums. 9216 values on stage 0 (3 layers × (2 LN × 1024 + 2 biases × 512)), 10240 on stage 1 (+ final LN).
Megatron: finalize_model_grads.py:452 (_allreduce_non_tensor_model_parallel_grads); here: allreduce_sequence_parallel_grads in train_gpt.py.
